SINGLEPLAYERCARD-DEMONIC_SHIELD_SOLO.des: Lose 1 HP. Gain Block equal to the HP you have lost this combat.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TANK_SOLO.title: Tank
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TANK_SOLO.description: Take 50% more damage from enemies. Reflect all blocked Attack damage back at the attacker.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-MIDNIGHT_SOLO.title: Midnight
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-MIDNIGHT_SOLO.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Costs 1 less for each card in your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
Costs 2 less this turn for each card [gold]Exhausted[/gold] this turn.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BLAZE_SOLO.title: Blaze
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BLAZE_SOLO.description: Gain {Strength:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] for each card you have discarded this turn.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-OUTRAGE_SOLO.title: Outrage
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-OUTRAGE_SOLO.descriptio:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add a copy of this card to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] for itself, plus one more for each other copy of this card in your hand.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-PINCER_ATTACK_SOLO.desc: This turn, the enemy takes double damage from Attack cards not currently in your hand.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-STEALTH_SOLO.title: Stealth
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-STEALTH_SOLO.descriptio: [gold]Sly.[/gold] Whenever you deal damage by means other than an Attack card, gain {StealthPowerSolo:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BLADE_SYMPHONY_SOLO.des: Play every [gold]Shiv[/gold] in your Discard Pile or Exhaust Pile (Upgraded).
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CONCOCT_SOLO.title: Concoct
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CONCOCT_SOLO.descriptio: Give all un-enchanted Attack cards in your hand [gold]Venomous {Venomous:diff()}[/gold].
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-SHADOW_VANISH_SOLO.desc: [gold]Retain.[/gold] This turn, gain Dexterity equal to the number of non-Skill cards in your hand.
